title: Assessing gender bias in medical and scientific masked language models with StereoSet
benchmark_measurement: Detection of stereotyped biases in religious contexts using a fill-in-the-blank task from the StereoSet benchmark.
findings: Medical Masked Language Models (MLMs) generally showed more religious bias (lower StereoSet scores ranging from 46-54) compared to the general-purpose MLMs (score of 58). The religious bias scores for the two general-purpose models, BERT and RoBERTa, were identical.
